page.layout: One page, a centred title page. From top to bottom: a running line in small capitals; the large title in two lines; a subtitle in italic; a woodcut engraving of a tree with a banner and a figure; the imprint in three lines, with the date line below.
page.notes: Engraving between the subtitle and the imprint: a tree with spreading branches, a serpent coiled around its trunk, and a figure standing at its right. A banner across the lower left reads "NON SOLUS". This is part of the woodcut, not running text. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The title lines were set in spaced capitals; the Roman numerals of the date are written in the modern form.
